text:
Marta Ruiz: Dropping Aurora Systems co-marketing assets. Need quick lockup QA for marketplace tiles, alt text for the hero, and a short legal consent for a client quote. Files: https://aurora.example.com/partner-assets.zip

Ethan Cole: Quick visual note: their mark has microserifs that disappear at small sizes. Suggest stacked emblem for 240x240 tiles and a bold outline for dark backgrounds. I'll make SVG variants. :art:

Priya Shah: Marketplace sizes: AWS hero 600x315, Azure hero 1200x627, GCP tile 300x300. We require 72dpi PNGs and a 24px safe zone. Alt text should mention the 30% cost reduction claim if partner confirms.

Marta Ruiz: Partner quote draft: "Aurora + Redwood reduced per-request cost by ~30% in production." Need attribution (name/title) and timeframe.

LegalBot: Flag: "~30%" is a quant claim. Please get baseline, timeframe, and signed approval email from Aurora. Also add trademark line: "Aurora Systems\u2122 is a trademark of Aurora Systems, Inc."

Leo (Aurora Systems): Confirmed. Baseline: Jan1025 vs Apr1025 rollout, internal billing logs. PM will email explicit approval and a full-name attribution. We approve the alt text: "Cover: Aurora Systems and Redwood Inference solution brief showing ~30% per-request cost reduction."

Ethan Cole: Uploaded exports to staging: https://redwood.assets.internal/aurora/exports_v1.zip includes hero/tile/favicon and outlined SVGs.

Marta Ruiz: Actions: 1) @Ethan finalize marketplace PNGs and push to marketplace/images/aurora. 2) @Priya wait for partner email and add attribution. 3) @LegalBot prepare trademark/consent snippet for signatures. Target: Friday EOD. Any blockers?

Priya Shah: No blockers, will hold quote.

LegalBot: Starting consent flow now.

Leo (Aurora Systems): Email with metrics and PM signature sent. Thanks everyone! :handshake:

Marta Ruiz: Great, thanks. React with :white_check_mark: when done so I can bundle the co-launch assets."
